system.description: As a Swift Action, the Beast produces a piercing, high-pitched sound. The Beast makes an attack roll (1d20+10) against the Fortitude Defense of every character within 6 squares of it. If the attack succeeds, the target takes a -5 circumstance penalty on Perception checks and skill checks requiring concentration, and the target has difficulty hearing until the end of the Beast's next turn.
